Image Resizer

Resize any image to exact pixel dimensions with an aspect-ratio lock, quick presets and percentage scaling. Preview the result and download as PNG, JPG or WebP.

📐 Drop an image here or click to browse

Pixel presets fit the longest side. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose an image — its current dimensions appear automatically.
  2. Type the new width and height (aspect ratio stays locked unless you untick it), or tap a preset like 1920px, 1280px, 50% or 25%.
  3. Pick an output format (PNG, JPG or WebP) and set quality for JPG/WebP.
  4. Click “Resize image”, preview the result and download it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will my image get stretched?

Yes — “Lock aspect ratio” is on by default. Change either the width or the height and the other updates automatically so the image never stretches.

Does resizing reduce the file size?

The pixel dimensions always change. The file size usually shrinks when you downscale, but upscaling or choosing PNG can make it larger.

Is my image uploaded?

No. Everything is drawn on a canvas in your browser — your image is never uploaded anywhere.
